Write programs using the available functions:

regex_split :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> list(tsubstr)

regex_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tfullstr

regex_tail :: list(tsubstr) -> tsubstr

regex_append :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_reverse_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_or_add_characters_based_on_conditions :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: This function takes a full string, a substring to add or replace, and a substring to search for. It checks each character in the full string and performs the following actions based on conditions: if the search substring is found, it replaces it with the specified substring; if not found, it adds the specified substring before the search substring.

add_or_replace_characters_after_first_letter :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: This function takes a full string, a substring to add or replace, and a substring to search for. It concatenates the first letter of the full string with the specified substring, and then appends the rest of the full string after splitting it by '.'.

vowel_or_consonant_check :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: Checks if a character is a vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') and returns true if it is a vowel, false otherwise.

replace_end_letter_based_on_conditions :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: This function takes a full string, a substring to add or replace, and a substring to search for. It appends the specified substring to the concatenation of the full string and the first specified substring, then replaces the last character of the resulting string based on conditions provided by the third substring.

replace_end_letter_with_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: Replaces the last letter of a full string with a specified substring based on the split by '.'

replace_or_transform_based_on_separator :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: This function takes a full string and a transformation function that operates on substrings separated by '.'. It applies the transformation function to each substring in the full string and returns the modified full string.

add_or_replace_end_letter :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: Adds or replaces the last letter of a full string with a specified substring.

replace_or_add_with_condition :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_or_add_characters_based_on_conditions $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: Replaces or adds characters in a full string based on specified conditions. If the substring to search for is found, it is replaced with a modified substring. If not found, the modified substring is added before the search substring.

replace_p_with_condition :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) $1 $0)) (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: Replaces occurrences of 'p' in a full string with a specified substring based on conditions provided by the second substring.

replace_first_letter_based_on_separator :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: Replaces the first letter of a full string with a specified substring based on the split by '.'
